en.sayed-ali-raza: Praise be to Him Who makes praise followed by bounty and bounty with gratefulness.
We praise Him on His bounties as on His trails.
We seek His help against these hearts which are slow to obey what they have been commended but quick towards what they have been desisted from.
We seek His forgiveness from that which His knowledge covers and His document preserves
knowledge which does not leave anything and document which does not omit anything.
We believe in Him like the belief of one who has seen the unknown and has attained the promised rewards
— belief, the purity whereof keeps off from belief in partners of Allāh, and whose conviction removes doubt.
